# Phase Three — Thirty Final Refinements

1. Verify `dialogFocus.js` exact header, tabs, syntax, and <120 lines.
2. Verify focus restoration returns a boolean rather than throwing.
3. Verify duplicate lifecycle bind uses dataset testimony safely.
4. Verify non-DOM tests remain safe.
5. Verify native dialog close event path.
6. Verify fallback close path explicitly restores focus.
7. Verify Escape path converges on native close event.
8. Verify click-outside behavior if supported by current surface.
9. Verify commerce launcher remains 44px minimum.
10. Verify sheet has no horizontal overflow at 390px.
11. Verify focus-visible remains obvious at high contrast.
12. Verify retention favorite control remains after commerce surface refactor.
13. Verify product-memory browser cycle still works after surface change.
14. Verify reconciliation endpoint still passes no-write/no-identity tests.
15. Verify generated catalog/sitemap remain fresh.
16. Verify workspace descriptor target paths resolve to current catalog routes.
17. Verify embed protocol still rejects unknown versions/directions/origins.
18. Verify no parallel handoff storage format is introduced.
19. Verify handoff source remains usable if target launch fails.
20. Verify startup profile still shows the same dominant eager modules after UI changes.
21. Avoid touching legacy JSON config without a coherent migration design.
22. Audit game SKU semantics rather than only product counts.
23. Verify game paid actions map to handlers and reversible credit reservations.
24. Audit creator/developer action catalog for generic one-size-fits-all value.
25. Prefer product-specific benefit copy where action execution is already real.
26. Verify all new files have extensive JSDoc.
27. Split any touched file reaching 120 lines rather than removing comments.
28. Run current-tree tests only after all pending writes are confirmed on disk.
29. Re-read all touched files after final writes.
30. Write explicit completed, measured-debt, and remaining-work evidence.
